glosses: The fact or act of surviving; continued existence or life.

examples.text: His survival in the open ocean was a miracle; he had fully expected to die.

glosses: Of, relating to or aiding survival.

examples.text: persecution survival plan

examples.text: […] a team that have turned snatching relegation from the jaws of top-flight survival into an art form […]

glosses: A custom or belief that persists in folklore from earlier times, when the rationale behind it is forgotten.

examples.text: Thus, if some old rhyme or saying has in one place a solemn import in philosophy or religion, while elsewhere it lies at the level of the nursery, there is some ground for treating the serious version as the more original, and the playful one as its mere lingering survival.

The banded ones were all dressed in white gowns — a gay survival from Old Style days, when cheerfulness and May-time were synonyms — days before the habit of taking long views had reduced emotions to a monotonous average.

glosses: A mark left on the earth by a foot.

examples.text: Mais qu’a-t-il de si particulier, ce crabe ? À côté de nombreux aspects morphologiques spécifiques (citons seulement des yeux réduits à un vestige membranaire, l’animal étant aveugle), c’est la présence des soies qui a retenu l’attention des chercheurs.

examples.text: Un exemple remarquable de vestiges est celui des osselets auditifs des Mammifères.
